title: Delete the dead test/firestore-rules/ Jest suite, superseded by functions/test/firestore_rules.test.mjs
why: This suite is fully dead: ci.yml (lines 303-307, confirmed) only ever runs functions/test/firestore_rules.test.mjs, and this directory is invoked by no Makefile target. If anyone ran `npm test` here today every '[allow]' case would fail — it targets top-level `accounts`/`learner_profiles`/`track_configs`/`completion_events` collections that do not exist anywhere in the live nested users/{uid}/learner_profiles/{profileId}/... rules (confirmed by a full read of firestore.rules); they would all hit the global default-deny. Meanwhile docs/architecture.md:575, docs/development-guide.md:87, docs/deployment-guide.md:51 and docs/test-options.md:38 still describe `test/firestore-rules/` (Jest) as the live firestore-rules CI job, and docs/api-contracts.md:84 claims deprecated top-level rule blocks are 'retained because... test/firestore-rules/ pin them' — those blocks don't exist in firestore.rules at all. A contributor trusting any of those docs and editing this directory expecting it to gate CI wastes their change; the directory also drags in a fully duplicate devDependency set (jest, firebase, @firebase/rules-unit-testing) plus a committed package-lock.json for zero live test value.
recommendation: Delete test/firestore-rules/ (all 4 git-tracked files including package-lock.json) now that functions/test/firestore_rules.test.mjs is the confirmed canonical suite — the file's own header comment already says this is the intended endpoint ('kept only for reference until removed').
acceptance_criteria: test/firestore-rules/ directory removed from the tree (git rm)
The 4 canonical docs referencing test/firestore-rules/ as the live CI path are updated in the same change or a follow-up doc-drift ticket is filed
